payload.note: Seven-kernel power-carrier checkpoint: global momentum inversion pairs the 14 unfactorized generic-L complete-g4 two-loop entries into seven exact kernels. For paired arguments, 24*K4(k,-k,r,-r)=x^2+y^2+2*(omega(k)+omega(r))*C+4*omega(k)*omega(r), with C>=0, proving omega(k)*omega(r)/6 <= K4 <= 19*omega(k)*omega(r)/6. The momentum-dependent tadpole Y_L(k) is therefore positive and comparable to omega(k)*G1(L). The inversion pair from Cov(U31^2,-U40) factorizes as T_L=-(216/N)*sum_q K3(p,q,-p-q)^2*Y_L(q)/[omega(q)^4*omega(p+q)^2]. Retaining one transverse lowest mode proves T_L<=-(N-1)/[4*N*omega(p)]<=-(624/625)*L^2/(16*pi^2) for every L>=5. Hence g_L^4 times this isolated carrier diverges on the tuned branch and termwise order-g4 uniform estimates are obstructed. Cancellation across the complete seven-kernel sum, factorized/lower-loop recombination, full M4, the nonperturbative score, and actual interacting H^-1 remain open. A supporting O(L^4)-memory scan gives negative seven-kernel ratios to N*omega(p) at L=5,6,7,8 but is not used as theorem evidence. No continuum, Born, Krein, or Lorentzian promotion is made.
